title: UniversalTools: AI
description: AI coding agents and assistants: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, Gemini Code Assist, Cline, Continue, plus local and Hugging Face models through Ollama and the Hugging Face provider for Copilot Chat (GitHub Copilot Chat itself is built into VS Code).

title: Tablas - CSV, Parquet, SQLite, DuckDB & Excel Viewer
description: Open CSV, Parquet, SQLite, DuckDB, and Excel (.xlsx) files in a pretty, theme-aware table view.

title: UniversalTools: DevOps & Config
description: Remote SSH and Remote Explorer, PowerShell, ShellCheck and shell-format for scripts, and support for nginx, Apache and systemd config files, log files and CSV.

title: reStructuredText Preview (docutils)
description: Accurate live preview for reStructuredText, rendered by docutils, with Sphinx and Zephyr roles and directives, scroll sync and syntax highlighting.

title: UnitySense
description: JetBrains Rider 수준의 Unity 개발 지능형 지원 확장 (ShaderLab/HLSL LSP, Roslyn 분석기, YAML 에셋 인덱서, .meta 자동 동기화).

title: Titan Architect Studio
description: Desenvolva plugins Titan com preview do shell, validação e FEX no VS Code.

title: DevJack
description: Blackjack beside your editor while Claude Code works: the table opens when Claude starts on a prompt and closes when it is done. Works with the Claude Code extension and the claude CLI.

title: Founder Fightclub — Pixel Coding Companions
description: Two or three tiny pixel founders fight and roast each other in the VS Code or Cursor bottom panel, and react to real editor errors.

title: AeroUI — macOS UI for Code Editors
description: macOS-inspired clean appearance, refined themes, presets, and UI controls for VS Code-compatible code editors.

title: Tortue Git
description: A TortoiseGit-inspired Git client for Visual Studio Code.

title: BlyxTorch
description: Train and evaluate dense CPU networks in Blyx. Includes native trainers, editable machine-learning projects and editor snippets.

title: Gerrit Workbench
description: Gerrit uploads, code reviews, comments, voting and change management in VS Code
